## Description

Forecasts the intraday volume curve and schedules child orders to participate more during high-liquidity intervals while respecting participation and urgency constraints.

## Where it may fit

Large orders across sessions with repeatable volume seasonality and known market-hours structure.

## Vehicles

Institutional equity, ETF, futures and execution desks.

## Required data

Historical intraday volume by time-of-day, live traded volume, spread/depth, target size, market calendar and benchmark.

## Caveats

Volume curves shift on news, auctions and half-days; forecast error and participation caps must be included in backtests.
